basis: Analyst crosswalk from ESA WorldCover classes to comparable USACE-published NLCD roughness ranges. These are depth-independent priors for appreciable flood depths, not field measurements or a calibrated Pakistan lookup.
limitations: WorldCover 2021 predates the August 2022 event; vegetation, crops and development may have changed.
WorldCover does not distinguish forest type, crop height, urban density or channel bed material. The selected values are provisional within published comparable-class ranges.
Built-up resistance approximates unresolved obstructions; it does not create buildings, roads, walls, bridges or levees in the terrain.
The open-water prior does not establish actual channel roughness. Bed material, vegetation, flow depth and bank condition need local review.
Published ranges are not probability distributions or confidence limits. No coefficients were selected using withheld Nowshera observations.
Snow, ice, moss, lichen, mangrove and unknown classes are refused without an additional justified local crosswalk.

classes.name: Tree cover
classes.rationale: Forest-type uncertainty retained across the published forest ranges.

classes.name: Shrubland
classes.rationale: Comparable shrub/scrub vegetation; density and height require field review.

classes.name: Grassland
classes.rationale: Comparable grass/herbaceous cover under appreciable inundation depth.

classes.name: Cropland
classes.rationale: Cultivated-crop prior; no event-specific crop height or harvesting survey is available.

classes.name: Built-up
classes.rationale: Developed-density uncertainty retained; WorldCover supplies no impervious-fraction subclass.

classes.name: Bare sparse vegetation
classes.rationale: Comparable barren rock/sand/clay class; material is not surveyed.

classes.name: Permanent water channel prior
classes.rationale: Open-water/channel prior; does not infer grain size or validate bathymetry.

classes.name: Herbaceous wetland
classes.rationale: Comparable emergent herbaceous wetland; woody wetlands are not assumed.
